salmon.title: Splatoon 3 · Salmon Run
salmon.label: 스플래툰 3 · 새먼 런
salmon.evidence: Wave 2 countdown and assigned weapon before fog and real combat at local 6–23.8. Fogged wave at 26–105. Fog lifts after the wave and the next assignment appears at 109.5–126.5. Only ordinary gameplay is claimed. The version 2.0.0 issue and Big Run additions are reported from the Nintendo patch history.
rights: Squid, Kid, Salmonid, YouTube Creative Commons Attribution

patchRecord.evidence: Released November 29, 2022. Added Big Run event data. Fixed returning underwater after starting Inkjet immediately before the water rises. These conditions are documented by Nintendo; the adopted ordinary wave footage does not reproduce the fault or show Big Run.
